completion_policy.prototype: Instrumented bounded implementation or experiment with explicit limitations; not a completion claim.
completion_policy.complete: Acceptance evidence, comparative material coverage, conservation/work checks, refinement checks, and relevant scale/customer checks are recorded.

physical_reference.protocol: 0.10 m start and 0.10 m increases on the same pane until first observed fracture
physical_reference.claim_limit: First observed fracture after staircase history; not complete shattering, fragment distribution, contact force, impulse, or timing.
physical_reference.raw_data_policy: Retain the raw terminal-height distribution and protocol history; do not tune one deterministic threshold to the mean.

execution_policy.integration: Disjoint agents may prepare bounded slices; the parent owns shared-file review, serial builds, integrated verification, and regular non-force publication to main.

goals.next_action: Add bounded local mesh patches, material coordinates/layers and measured skin/contact error.

goals.title: Converged material/contact response and cutting
goals.objective: Converge glass, oak, iron, and soft-tissue contact/material response and cutting under force, work, time, and space gates without strength hacks.

prototype_gate: declared laws run for glass/oak/iron/soft tissue

complete_gate: time/iteration/space/contact refinement bounds force, work, area, topology, momentum, angular momentum, and energy residuals
oak has directional evidence
iron has calibrated plastic evidence

asymmetric/support/third-body cases pass

goals.next_action: Cross mesh/load increments and pressure-profile/element-orientation controls with predeclared error bounds; compare a locking-resistant formulation before dynamic contact and calibrated dent/fracture claims.
goals.evidence_status: Spring cache and endpoint rollback tests pass. The small-strain isotropic J2 material-point analytical, unloading/reloading, dissipation, rejection, and exact reload-continuation tests pass. It is not dent geometry, contact, finite strain, or calibrated iron. Glass/oak/tissue refinement and the full mechanical work ledger remain open. Connected small-strain isotropic/orthotropic/J2 tetrahedral equilibrium now passes analytical, reaction, rollback and state continuation checks. Low-load three-material controls recover; high-load plastic shape remains strongly spatially unconverged. Conservative partial-face pressure and optional assembled block-CSR tangent products now pass analytical, backend parity and transactional work-limit tests. Crossed high-load spatial refinement still fails; n=16 iron reaches the 64-million-block cap before unloading. The repeated kernel benchmark harness is smoke-tested; isolated p95/p99 qualification remains pending.

goals.title: Conservative thermal frontier
goals.objective: Add cross-region flux, cold-neighbor/frontier activation, and conservative accumulation while preserving phase, reaction, latent heat, and lag accounting.

prototype_gate: cross-region interface flux is equal and opposite
frontier activation reports cause and error bound

complete_gate: timestep/space refinement closes heat, enthalpy, latent, fuel/oxygen, and interface residuals
activation/demotion are transactional

law envelope limits fire/weakening claims

goals.next_action: Bound omitted boundary heat error, refine frontier/time/space thresholds, then add conservative cooling/demotion and cross-clock transfers.
goals.evidence_status: Opt-in bounded cold-neighbor frontier, transfer ledgers, reactive/phase history, strict commands and grow-first versus fully preactivated oracles pass; global omitted-flux error is not bounded.

goals.next_action: Extend one shared declaration and bounded load/validate/step/query/export command surface across chat, CLI, and native tools after passing mocked chat and bounded live-package paths.
goals.evidence_status: All 29 mocked playground HTTP tests pass and a bounded live call produced an independently validated package. Full mechanical/thermal state and ledger unification remains open and no completion is claimed.

goals.title: Measured world-load performance
goals.objective: Optimize measured active-world kernels and sparse-active scheduling without changing laws; keep cold storage out of full simulation.

prototype_gate: storage and allocator overhead are separated
p50/p95/p99, backlog, age, residual, lag, and memory are reported
fixed and growing active-count matrices exist
only measured kernels are optimized
cold storage is not fully simulated
complete_gate: declared scale/load matrices meet budgets or report bounded backlog
1M and 16M stored-voxel cases are measured at 256, 1024, 4096, and 16384 active cells
growing contact and wake churn are measured
the 60 Hz 16.67 ms full-frame engineering target is evaluated on named hardware
CPU-reference outputs and residuals remain within declared tolerances
no world-scale realtime claim comes from a small fixture

goals.next_action: Run the named-hardware 1M/16M stored-voxel by 256/1024/4096/16384 active-cell matrix with growing contact and wake churn; report physics, full-frame, backlog, and residuals separately.
goals.evidence_status: 4/256/4096 chunks retain identical 336-active-cell local physics at 10 s across 3 repeats; headless thermal p95 is about 0.36-0.37 ms and tight 1000-operation budgets report backlog. The 2 m/s native playground case measured 50 active frames and 31.25 ms p95 full-frame time, which does not qualify the 60 Hz target. The target is not a measured promise. Conservative partial-face pressure and optional assembled block-CSR tangent products now pass analytical, backend parity and transactional work-limit tests. Crossed high-load spatial refinement still fails; n=16 iron reaches the 64-million-block cap before unloading. The repeated kernel benchmark harness is smoke-tested; isolated p95/p99 qualification remains pending.

manifests support validation/preview/permissions/migration
authority/bandwidth/determinism behavior is measured
ax/tree, door/panel, and tomato bowl pass customer conformance

goals.next_action: Define snapshot manifest and compatibility matrix; run crash/restart, migration rejection, publish/import, and customer-loop fixtures.

goals.title: Compact persistence, history, and repair
goals.objective: Persist an immutable base plus sparse versioned state deltas so cold worlds render quickly and accepted physical history resumes without healing, reset, or duplicate work.

prototype_gate: lossless supported finite IEEE-754 state with explicit signed-zero policy
nonfinite, corrupt, stale, partial, wrong-version, and wrong-base input rejects transactionally
reload produces the exact next accepted increment
compact asleep render cost and reactivation cost are measured separately
complete_gate: crash-atomic checkpoint or journal records have checksums and monotonic revisions
repair selects a verified prefix and reports discarded records
save/reload preserves trajectories, topology, lineage, ledgers, clocks, material history, inventory, and player history
rollback and compatibility behavior are explicit and tested

efficient gameplay repair is bounded, consumes explicit material and energy receipts, restores declared stress/geometry/topology, uses collision-safe placement, preserves the old revision, and reports work/delay

goals.next_action: Define the broader state IDs, scalar ordering, fingerprints, journal, and repair semantics; extend beyond numeric material points to geometry, world state, rendering, and bounded reactivation.
goals.evidence_status: NumericStateDelta and the fixed-size 14-double J2 history pass same-bit round-trip, old-revision retention, and exact next-material-increment continuation. Scope is numeric material-point state only; no geometry, world dent, render, save-game, crash-repair, or full-world-reactivation claim. Full spatial patch JSON round-trip and next-load state parity now pass against the same immutable definition; compact spatial codec and fingerprint-authenticated world continuation remain open.

goals.title: Intrinsic property variation and uncertainty
goals.objective: Represent fixed intrinsic heterogeneity with deterministic versioned samples keyed by persisted seed and stable object, element, and property IDs.

intrinsic heterogeneity, stochastic physical state, calibration uncertainty, and numerical error are reported separately
no glass flaw calibration claim is made without matching population evidence

goals.next_action: Persist the verified PropertyVariation seed contract, then connect it only through an explicit constitutive law and ensemble/calibration tests.
goals.evidence_status: Portable golden-value, reordered-access, and 100000-seed bounds tests pass. The sampler changes no force by itself and is not a calibrated glass flaw distribution.

goals.next_action: Extend the verified basic native path through edit/follow-up, unsupported capability, cancellation, inventory, save/reload, and receipt-backed repair tests while retaining mock coverage, independent validation, bounded calls, and secret isolation.
goals.evidence_status: All 29 mocked HTTP tests pass in 2.140 seconds. Live gpt-5-mini job ff0c7d0f1eaa4c4a9f50f8ef7d486202 produced a validated iron-ball versus glass/oak/iron package at 2 and 6 m/s; both headless and native cases completed 480 steps/1 s and the studio was visible. The actual-native validator caught forbidden rigid_drop network fields, which were fixed. The basic gate passes; broader edit, persistence, cancellation, inventory, unsupported, and repair gates remain open. Live GPT spatial-pressure request opens the actual computed native sequence, with glass/iron complete and oak solver_limit. Direct CLI and chat-generated reports match except solve timing.

goals.title: Property-based material contracts
goals.implementation: Validate SI density and elastic/orthotropic/J2 parameters, units, state layout and supported combinations. Physical identity excludes display names.
goals.acceptance: Unseen names and numeric parameter sets execute the same native material law; invalid values and unsupported models fail explicitly.

goals.title: Shared inertial deformable state
goals.implementation: Reuse tetrahedral geometry and constitutive state for nodal mass, velocity, internal force and irreversible history. Transactional steps and explicit stability/work limits.
goals.acceptance: Translation/free-fall oracles, support reactions, rollback, elastic refinement and persistent plastic history pass without name-based branches.

goals.title: Coupled dynamic contact
goals.implementation: Surface triangle/shape contact, consistent equal-and-opposite reactions, friction, continuous collision handling and coupled material updates.
goals.acceptance: Sphere on deformable patches: no tunneling; contact impulse, external work, stored energy and numerical losses balance under timestep/mesh refinement.

goals.title: Recoverable flexible materials
goals.implementation: Finite-strain elasticity for large rubber-like deformation, then explicit viscoelastic internal state and relaxation. Small-strain elasticity alone is not rubber.
goals.acceptance: Ball deforms target, releases stored energy and rebounds; shape recovery, frequency dependence and refinement compared against references; no restitution-only substitute.

goals.title: Permanent impact deformation
goals.implementation: Connect J2 history to contact-driven spatial motion, unloading and rendered residual geometry.
goals.acceptance: Impact leaves a measured residual dent, low-energy control recovers; glass/oak/iron comparisons plus new alloys; persistent reload reproduces geometry and subsequent response.

goals.title: Stable progressive fracture
goals.implementation: Resolve localized stress/energy release with length-scale-aware fracture, transactional topology changes and connected fragments. Include thin-plate/shell representation where needed.
goals.acceptance: Thin glass impact completes and propagates cracks from loading; fracture energy, fragment mass and momentum audited; timestep/mesh refinement; wood does not become glass by naming.

goals.title: Compact state and repair
goals.implementation: Serialize only supported canonical deformation, damage, plastic/thermal history and topology deltas; render skins from physical state; budget history and reference repair.
goals.acceptance: Reload damaged objects exactly within declared tolerance, contact immediately, repair explicitly with resource/energy accounting and bounded state size.

goals.title: LLM authoring and experiment contracts
goals.implementation: LLM emits validated unit-bearing materials, geometries, initial/boundary conditions, supported law compositions, controls and machine-checkable expectations.
goals.acceptance: Fresh randomized requests generate unseen parameter sets through the public API and render actual native trajectories; unsupported requirements never silently substitute.

goals.title: Realtime execution and compiled behaviors
goals.implementation: Profile active islands, sleeping regions, compiled law kernels, conservative LOD and state-keyed offline models with applicability/invalidation checks. Keep LLM out of per-frame execution.
goals.acceptance: Publish hardware, active interaction counts, p50/p95/p99 cost, memory and overload policy; target 60 Hz total frame with physics budget <=4 ms on declared reference hardware, qualify before promising.

goals.title: Cross-material release gate
goals.implementation: Run a held-out matrix of known/novel materials, shapes, speeds, thicknesses, temperature/state and histories; preserve energy/phase/fire and other existing goals.
goals.acceptance: Required shatter/dent/flex cases plus unseen supported compositions pass without engine edits per material. Evidence includes source/material hashes, direct contact and energy telemetry, refinement and LLM assessment separated from facts.
